title: Kahn's Algorithm
problemStatement: Kahn’s algorithm: BFS topological sort using indegrees.
intuition: Repeatedly take indegree-0 nodes. Natural for “levels” of prerequisites.

approaches.title: Brute: try all permutations
approaches.idea: Check edge order constraints — factorial blow-up.

approaches.title: Optimal: Kahn
approaches.code:
from collections import defaultdict, deque

def kahn(n, edges):
    g = defaultdict(list)
    indeg = [0] * n
    for u, v in edges:
        g[u].append(v)
        indeg[v] += 1
    q = deque([i for i in range(n) if indeg[i] == 0])
    order = []
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        order.append(u)
        for v in g[u]:
            indeg[v] -= 1
            if indeg[v] == 0:
                q.append(v)
    return order if len(order) == n else []

interviewInsight: Kahn is easier to extend to “levels” / parallel courses.
